notes: Editable spending caps for OpenAI generation in this project (user has ~$25 credit total). total_cap_usd covers ALL tracked OpenAI spending across every stage. bucket_caps_usd additionally limits named buckets; the 'preliminary' bucket (screening + controls stages) is capped at $5. The evaluation stage has no sub-cap of its own -- it is bounded only by the $20 total, which leaves ~$5 unspent as a buffer outside planned spending. Caps are limits, not targets -- they are never raised automatically. The ledger tracks only this pipeline's requests, not the account's real balance or spending made elsewhere.
